name: Ksenia

skills.name: Special Discount
skills.description: Selects 1 enemy target within 6 tiles and deals Physical damage equal to 80% of attack to them.

skills.name: Favorable Cycle
skills.description: Selects 1 enemy target within 6 tiles, deal Physical damage equal to 75% of attack to it and apply 2 stacks of Flammable, as well as Overburn for 1 turn. If under the effects of 2 or more Burn buffs, performs an additional attack on the original target, dealing Burn damage equal to 75% of attack and 2 Stability Damage.

skills.name: Comprehensive Rescue
skills.description: Selects 1 allied target within 6 tiles, restoring HP equal to 130% of attack, 2 points of Stability Index, and applies Heat Recovery. If the target's HP is fully restored after healing, applies Blazing Assault II for 2 turns.

skills.name: The Secret of Making Money
skills.description: The user gains Heat Recovery and Blazing Assault II for 2 turns. Select 1 enemy target within 6 tiles and deal Burn damage equal to 160% of attack to it.

skills.name: Passion for Shopping
skills.description:
When an enemy unit within range receives targeted damage from an allied unit, prioritizes performing 1 instance of Action Support, dealing Physical damage equal to 80% of attack and 3 points of Stability Damage to the enemy unit, and applies Blazing Assault II to the allied unit for 2 turns. This can be triggered up to once per turn.

When under the effects of Heat Recovery, Stability Damage is increased by 1 point respectively. At the end of the action, gains 1 point of Confectance Index for each Burn buff.

fortification.effect: Apply Overburn for 1 turn after the first attack.
When under the effects of Blazing Assault, increases Stability Damage dealt by 1 point.
If a phase weakness is exploited, increases damage dealt by 20%.
The maximum amount of times that Action Support can trigger increases by 1.
If the target's HP is fully restored after healing and wasn't full before that, additionally restores 2 points of their Stability Index.
When attacking targets with Overburn, increase critical rate by 100%.

keys.name: Fixed Key 1 - Win-Win Partnership
keys.effect: When healing an allied target other than the user, applies 1 random buff to them and the user.

keys.name: Fixed Key 2 - Equivalent Exchange
keys.effect: When using Favorable Cycle, for each kill made, increases the maximum number of Action Support uses this turn by 1.

keys.name: Fixed Key 3 - Steady Income
keys.effect: After dealing Burn damage, restores HP equal to 10% of damage and 1 point of Stability Index.

keys.name: Fixed Key 4 - Mutual Benefit
keys.effect: When using Comprehensive Rescue, the user gains the same buffs

keys.name: Fixed Key 5 - Friendship Gift
keys.effect: When applying a Burn buff, additiionally cleanses 1 debuff.

keys.name: Fixed Key 6 - Discount Guide
keys.effect: If the user possesses Heat Recovery at the end of the action, gains 1 point of Confectance Index.

keys.name: Common Key - Blazing Inferno
keys.effect: HP +3.0% / When applying a Burn buff, there is a 50% chance to apply 1 additional buff to the target for 1 turn.

keys.name: Expansion Key
keys.effect: At the end of the action, restores 2 Stability for the ally with the lowest Stability
